AgentCore spans only appear as traces after this is enabled. If it's off, you typically see only the logs. Spans can take about 10 minutes to become searchable after you enable it.

- **AgentCore Runtime-hosted:** Instrumentation is automatic. Just make sure `aws-opentelemetry-distro` (ADOT) is in your dependencies. The docs' current example pins `~=0.21.0`.
